wins: Consistently accrued maximum per-episode reward (80) which demonstrates stable execution of low-level actions.

fails: Failed to satisfy success criteria in the only episode despite high reward, indicating missing final validation or objective completion.

key_outcomes.summary: Rewards were consistently high but the agent never closed the loop on the mission objective—needs targeted tactical adjustments to convert reconnaissance into confirmed success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Post-reconnaissance stage, agent stalls without invoking privilege escalation or exploit payload, causing episode to terminate without success.
